text.content:
name: changed
version: 1.0.0
description: Portable enterprise forest, carrier placement, and shared inference tenancy.
nodes:
  dc:
    type: compute
    os: windows
    resources:
      ram: 2 GiB
      cpu: 2
    endpoint_persona: service
  idp:
    type: compute
    os: linux
    resources:
      ram: 1 GiB
      cpu: 1
    endpoint_persona: service
    services:
    - name: oidc
      port: 8443
  carrier:
    type: compute
    os: linux
    resources:
      ram: 2 GiB
      cpu: 2
    endpoint_persona: carrier
  workforce:
    type: compute
    os: windows
    resources:
      ram: 1 GiB
      cpu: 1
    endpoint_persona: workforce
  inference:
    type: compute
    os: linux
    resources:
      ram: 2 GiB
      cpu: 2
    endpoint_persona: service
    services:
    - name: inference-api
      port: 8080
accounts:
  domain-admin:
    username: Administrator
    node: dc
identity_domains:
  corp:
    profile: active_directory
    dns_name: corp.example
    netbios_name: CORP
    authority_account_ref: domain-admin
identity_forests:
  enterprise:
    root_domain_ref: corp
    domain_refs:
    - corp
identity_facades:
  workforce-oidc:
    service_ref: nodes.idp.services.oidc
    protocol: oidc
deployment_tenants:
  range-a: {}
  shared-platform: {}
deployment_cells:
  range-a-cell:
    tenant_ref: range-a
    node_refs:
    - dc
    - idp
    - carrier
    - workforce
    cross_tenant_isolation: default_deny
  shared-cell:
    tenant_ref: shared-platform
    node_refs:
    - inference
    cross_tenant_isolation: default_deny
relationships:
  dc-role:
    type: domain_controller_for
    source: dc
    target: corp
    domain_controller: {}
  workforce-federation:
    type: directory_federates_to
    source: enterprise
    target: workforce-oidc
    identity_federation:
      direction: authority_to_facade
      protocol: ldap_tls
      mapping_intent: groups_to_roles
      tenant_claim_name: range_instance
      tenant_claim_owner: facade
  workforce-placement:
    type: placed_on_carrier
    source: workforce
    target: carrier
    carrier_placement:
      kernel_boundary: shared_kernel
  shared-inference:
    type: uses_shared_service
    source: range-a
    target: nodes.inference.services.inference-api
    shared_service:
      tenant_isolation: stateless
      workload_authentication: tenant_scoped_workload_identity
      mutable_state_refs: []
      mutable_state_owner: none
      reset_generation_owner: none
